{{Quote|That was it. I pulled everyone off that ship.|Captain of the ''Band Light''|<ref name="Terror" />}}
A '''captain''' was in command of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Band Light]]'', which was suspected of [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and the rest of the crew came across a derelict [[Etti Lighter|''Etti''-class light transport]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="Terror" /> at some point before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''The Force Unleashed II'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the databank have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref> They were happy to find it at first, but after investigating the ship for a while, three of the ''Band Light''{{'s}} crew mysteriously [[Death/Legends|died]]. The captain pulled everyone off of the light [[Transport/Legends|transport]], but the ''Band Light'' began having problems. The captain initially thought that the deaths and strange occurrences on the ''Band Light'' were just accidents, but they were in truth caused by an Imperial [[Terror Trooper]].<ref name="Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
The captain of the ''Band Light'' was mentioned in the "[[Terror Trooper]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="Terror" />
